text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: People are calling this year's autumn Tenno Sho a duel for the top between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a battle between extraordinary athletes. Sakura Chiyono O may not have what it takes to compete against them…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if she wants to become Maruzensky's rival, Sakura Chiyono O can't lose, no matter who her opponent may be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Maruzensky arrives at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart pounds with anticipation at the future Sakura Chiyono O is on the cusp of revealing.
